Q1.rationale: The NDA contains no prohibition on reverse engineering, disassembling or decompiling objects embodying Confidential Information.
Q1.label: NotMentioned

Q2.rationale: Section 7 requires return or destruction on the Provider's request at any time, not upon termination of the Agreement, and Section 20 only sets an end date without a return duty.
Q2.label: NotMentioned

Q3.rationale: Segments 23 and 24 state the Agreement grants no license or other right, title or interest in the Evaluation Material.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: Segment 9 defines Evaluation Material as any information furnished in any form, with no requirement that it be designated, which is incompatible with a rule that all Confidential Information must be expressly identified.
Q4.label: Contradiction

Q5.rationale: Segment 9 defines Evaluation Material to include business, financial condition, operations, assets, personnel and contracts, not only technical information.
Q5.label: Contradiction

Q6.rationale: Section 4 bars disclosing that discussions or negotiations are taking place and the terms or status of them without written consent.
Q6.label: Entailment

Q7.rationale: Section 20 says the Agreement and all its obligations terminate two years after its date, which is incompatible with obligations surviving termination, though Section 7 continues obligations after return of materials.
Q7.label: Contradiction

Q8.rationale: Segment 14 excludes information independently developed by the Recipient without use of or reference to the Evaluation Material.
Q8.label: Entailment

Q9.rationale: Segment 37 allows the Recipient to retain one copy for archival, legal and compliance purposes after return or destruction, and segment 39 keeps the obligations in place.
Q9.label: Entailment

Q10.rationale: Segment 9 defines Evaluation Material to include information whether oral, written, electronic or otherwise.
Q10.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: Segment 37 contemplates a retained copy, and segment 9 covers notes and analyses prepared by the Recipient based on the information.
Q11.label: Entailment

Q12.rationale: Segment 15 defines Representatives to include agents, advisors, attorneys, accountants, consultants, bankers and financial advisors who need to know, and segment 21 permits disclosure to them.
Q12.label: Entailment

Q13.rationale: Segment 41 prohibits soliciting or engaging senior or key employees and other employees the Recipient had contact with, for eighteen months and two months thereafter.
Q13.label: Entailment

Q14.rationale: Segment 31 requires the Recipient to give prompt written notice of any legally required or requested disclosure so the Provider may seek a protective order.
Q14.label: Entailment

Q15.rationale: Segment 13 excludes information obtained from a source other than the Provider that was not bound by a confidentiality obligation, which implies the Recipient may acquire such information.
Q15.label: Entailment

Q16.rationale: Segment 15 includes employees and officers among Representatives, and segment 21 permits disclosure to Representatives who need to know.
Q16.label: Entailment

Q17.rationale: Segment 20 requires the Recipient to use the Evaluation Material solely for evaluating a Possible Transaction.
Q17.label: Entailment
